findings.explanation: Lean proves by reflexivity that `instance_ FEMPTY i name ty τ` equals the value of the Hilbert-choice witness for `instance_spec` at those arguments. HOL4 saves only the conditional specification. On `FEMPTY`, the lookup premise fails for every name. With Boolean results, flipping a satisfying function’s value on the empty signature preserves the saved specification while changing its value there. Thus HOL4 leaves its equality to that particular witness open.
findings.repair:
private theorem instance_exists : ∃ f, instance_spec (U := U) f := by sorry

private opaque specifiedInstance : { f // instance_spec (U := U) f } :=
  ⟨Classical.choose instance_exists, Classical.choose_spec instance_exists⟩

def instance_ : tmsig → interpretation U → mlstring → type → tyval U → U :=
  (specifiedInstance (U := U)).val

theorem instance_def : instance_spec (U := U) instance_ :=
  (specifiedInstance (U := U)).property
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSemantics
open Candle HOL

example (i : interpretation Bool) (name : mlstring) (ty : Candle.type) (τ : tyval Bool) :
    instance_ FEMPTY i name ty τ =
      (Classical.epsilon (instance_spec (U := Bool))) FEMPTY i name ty τ := rfl

findings.explanation: HOL4’s saved abstraction equation covers only `Abs (Var x ty) b`. Lean assigns `HOL.ARB` to every abstraction whose binder is a `Const`, `Comb`, or `Abs`. For example, Lean proves that `Abs (Const name ty) b` evaluates to `HOL.ARB` for every body and valuation. The HOL4 equations leave that value open.
findings.repair:
-- Before termsem0:
private opaque malformedAbsSem (mem : U → U → Prop) (tmsig : tmsig)
    (i : interpretation U) (v : valuation U) (binder body : term) : U :=
  tmvof v default

-- Replace the three ARB clauses after the variable-binder clause:
  | v, Abs binder b => malformedAbsSem mem tmsig i v binder b
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSemantics
open Candle HOL

example (mem : Bool → Bool → Prop) (Γ : tmsig) (i : interpretation Bool)
    (v : valuation Bool) (name : mlstring) (ty : Candle.type) (b : term) :
    termsem0 mem Γ i v (Abs (Const name ty) b) = (HOL.ARB : Bool) := by
  simp only [termsem0]
